notes: Sophos v0.7.1 (Beta) — Profile Studio (Creator mode made visual): build your own agent profiles from the live runtime with hot reload and in-memory testing, plus profile export/import with native dialogs and collision-safe round-trips. Builds on the v0.7 conversation-first shell, automatic local-model detection, agent profiles with the Gauntlet baseline and Standard / Minimal / Creator / Code modes, the Trajectory event log, and Code Mode's typed TypeScript tool SDK. 1113 unit tests. All versions before v1.0 are beta.
